data.standardized_narrative: Unable to reliably extract gross claims opening reserves or a gross prior-year-reserve movement from the scanned images provided. The scanned PDF pages are low-resolution and rotated, preventing accurate reading of the Balance Sheet 'Claims outstanding' line and the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note. Gross premiums written (total) was readable from the income statement, but detailed segmental and reserve movement tables could not be parsed with confidence.
data.data_quality_notes: Source documents are scanned, rotated and low-resolution images. I could read the 'Gross premiums written' total (shown as GBP 223,899 in the statement; converted to millions = 223.899) but could not reliably locate or read the Balance Sheet line 'Provision for outstanding claims' (gross claims outstanding) or the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note in a way that yields unambiguous gross figures. No gross claims development triangle was confidently extractable from the images. Therefore opening reserves and prior-year development are returned null. If a higher-quality, correctly oriented PDF or images of the specific notes/pages are provided I can extract the requested numeric reserve amounts and triangles.
